visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a vertical white signpost featuring a red arrow and the text '小網神社', standing in front of lush green trees and a utility pole under bright daylight. (2) The scene cuts to the front of Koami Shrine, a traditional wooden structure with white banners, as several visitors in casual summer clothing and face masks walk around the entrance area. (3) A close-up shot focuses on two bamboo pipes pouring continuous streams of clear water into a stone purification basin with large inscribed characters. (4) A hand enters the frame to touch the smooth, bald head of a small bronze Fukurokuju statue, which is positioned on a stone base near a wooden coin box. (5) A woman's hands are seen holding a small bamboo basket containing a 10,000 yen note and several silver coins, which she then lowers into a shallow stone water trough to perform the money-washing ritual. (6) The camera shows a stone turtle statue followed by a view of the shrine's service window, where amulets and wooden plaques are displayed for sale to visitors.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 東京日本橋的. (2) [Subtitle]: 小網神社. (3) [Subtitle]: 歷史超過500年. (4) [Subtitle]: 在東京大空襲時. (5) [Subtitle]: 整個城市幾乎被炸平. (6) [Subtitle]: 它卻毫髮無傷. (7) [Subtitle]: 從此被封為. (8) [Subtitle]: 強運除厄的代表. (9) [Subtitle]: 來這裡參拜. (10) [Subtitle]: 記得先二拜二拍手一拜. (11) [Subtitle]: 再找到可愛的福祿壽. (12) [Subtitle]: 投入零錢後. (13) [Subtitle]: 摸摸他的頭. (14) [Subtitle]: 據說能帶來. (15) [Subtitle]: 好運健康和財富. (16) [Subtitle]: 最後別錯過東京. (17) [Subtitle]: 有名的「錢洗弁天」. (18) [Subtitle]: 把錢放進清水中洗一洗. (19) [Subtitle]: 傳說會越花越多回來. (20) [Subtitle]: 下次來東京. (21) [Subtitle]: 記得試試把錢洗的乾乾淨淨. (22) [Subtitle]: 看看會不會越洗越有錢哦！. [Variety]: 越洗越有錢我！

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator delivering a steady, professional narration about the shrine's history. A cheerful acoustic guitar melody plays in the background, maintaining a moderate tempo and bright tonal quality. (2) Two sharp, resonant hand claps are heard, marking a transition into the ritual instruction phase; the narrator's voice remains clear and balanced against the music. (3) The narration continues over a very faint background layer of outdoor ambient noise, suggesting a quiet public space. The music maintains its rhythmic guitar strumming pattern. (4) A distinct, percussive splashing sound occurs as water is handled, followed by the sound of coins clinking faintly, which overlaps with the narrator's description of the money-washing ritual. (5) The narrator's pitch rises slightly in an encouraging tone for the closing remarks, and the acoustic guitar track slowly fades out alongside the last words.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Location Hook -> Historical Context -> Step-by-Step Ritual -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to introduce travelers to Koami Shrine in Tokyo by highlighting its miraculous survival during WWII and demonstrating the specific rituals (praying and money washing) believed to bring wealth and good fortune.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes a high-quality voiceover and clear on-screen subtitles to provide educational value about Japanese cultural practices.
